parameters.question: Compare rMATS A3SS junction-count event records, allowing column and row reordering. Require exact matches for chromosome, event positions, strand, and per-sample junction counts; require PSI, p-value, and FDR values to agree within an absolute tolerance of 0.01.
Compare rMATS A5SS junction-count event tables by biological event identifiers and splice-site coordinates, allowing row and column reordering and minor numeric rounding.
Compare rMATS skipped-exon event tables, aligning events by gene and exon coordinates while allowing row and column reordering and minor numeric rounding.
